commandNameMax: Command name must be at most {max} characters.
commandNameBang: Command name only carries the "!" in chat. Leave it out here.
alternateNameMax: Alternate name "{name}" must be at most {max} characters.
alternateNameBang: Alternate name "{name}" only carries the "!" in chat. Leave it out here.
aliasOwnName: "{name}" is already the command's own name.
responseLinesMax: Response can be at most {max} lines. Each line is sent as its own chat message.
responseCharsMax: Each line must be at most {max} characters.
responseFetchMax: A response can reference at most {max} different fetched values ({urlfetch:…}).
cooldownRange: Cooldown must be between 0 and {max} seconds.
cooldownInteger: Cooldown must be a whole number of seconds.
userIdNumeric: User restriction must be a numeric Twitch user id.
definitionNameMax: Definition name must be at most {max} characters.
definitionNameCharset: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores only.
urlMax: URL must be at most {max} characters.
urlPublic: URL must point at a public https host.
plainPath: A plain fetch reads the whole body. Clear the path or switch to json.
pathDepth: Path can be at most {max} segments deep.
pathSegment: "{segment}" cannot be used as a path segment: letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
keyLabelMax: Key label must be at most {max} characters.
fetchExists: A data source named "{name}" already exists.
fetchLimit: At most {max} data sources per channel.
